Here is a python solution to generate a palindrome of length at least 255:

```python
def generate_palindrome(min_length):
    # Generate first half of the string as random alphanumeric characters
    from random import choice
    import string
    first_half = ''.join(choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits) for i in range(min_length // 2))

    # Reverse the first half to make the second half
    second_half = first_half[::-1]

    # Concatenate both halves to form a palindrome
    palindrome = first_half + second_half

    # If desired length is odd, add one more random character in between
    if min_length % 2 == 1:
        palindrome += choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits)

    return palindrome

print(generate_palindrome(256))  # Generate a palindrome of minimum length 256
```

This program will output a palindrome of length at least 255. The first half of the palindrome is randomly generated from alphanumeric characters, and then the second half is just a reverse copy of the first half. If the desired length is odd, one more random character is added in between to ensure the palindrome has the exact specified length.

Please note that this program might generate very similar strings if you run it multiple times because it uses randomly generated data.
